payload.prompt: Which input types can a multimodal model work with at the same time?

options.rationale: Text is one type of input that multimodal models can use. Multimodal means more than one kind of data can be handled.
Images are one type of input that multimodal models can use. A model may use images with text in the same interaction.
Audio and video are also examples of data types that multimodal models may support. The key idea is working with multiple kinds of data.

options.error_type: confuses input data types with deployment configuration
options.rationale: Deployment names identify deployed models. They are not input data types like text, images, audio, or video.
options.better_fit: Use deployment names when calling a deployed model in application code.

feedback.intrinsic: The learner would mix up what a model receives with how a deployed model is named.
feedback.instructional: Inputs are the data sent to the model; deployment names are configuration details used when calling it.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Multimodal models can work with multiple kinds of data, such as text, images, audio, or video.

payload.prompt: Which actions describe vision-enabled GPT models?

options.rationale: Vision-enabled GPT models can analyze visual input. This is the vision part of GPT with vision.
Vision-enabled GPT models respond in natural language, meaning everyday written language. This makes them useful for answering questions about images.
They are designed for flexible, general-purpose visual reasoning. This means they can reason over different kinds of visual input.

options.error_type: confuses vision-enabled GPT with Sora video models
options.rationale: Creating short video clips is a video generation task. Vision-enabled GPT focuses on visual input and natural-language responses.
options.better_fit: Choose this when discussing Sora video generation models.

feedback.intrinsic: The learner would describe a video-generation job instead of visual reasoning with language.
feedback.instructional: Vision-enabled GPT analyzes images and answers in language; Sora models are used for generated video clips.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Vision-enabled GPT connects visual input with natural-language reasoning and answers.

payload.prompt: Which tasks can image-based models in Foundry support?

options.rationale: Foundry includes models that can describe what is in an image. This is a core image-based capability.

options.text: Extract meaning from charts or photos
options.rationale: Foundry image-based models can extract meaning from charts, screenshots, documents, or photos. Charts and photos both fit this capability.

options.text: Combine image understanding with text instructions
options.rationale: Foundry image-based models can combine visual understanding with text instructions in one prompt. This supports applications that use both an image and a user request.

options.text: Replace every app workflow with video output
options.error_type: confuses image analysis capabilities with video generation
options.rationale: Image-based models support analysis tasks such as description, questions, and meaning extraction. They do not mean every workflow becomes video output.
options.better_fit: Choose video output only when the task is specifically video generation.

feedback.intrinsic: The learner would overextend image analysis into a video-output workflow that is not needed.
feedback.instructional: Image-based models help applications understand visual content; video output is a separate generation task.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. These tasks match Foundry image-based model capabilities for understanding visual content.

payload.prompt: Which uses are common for GPT-4.1 multimodal models in Foundry?

options.rationale: Image description is a common use for GPT-4.1 multimodal models. These models can process text and images together.
Document and screenshot analysis are listed uses for GPT-4.1 models. These tasks require visual understanding with language.
Chart and diagram interpretation are common GPT-4.1 multimodal uses. The models can use the visual content and text together.

options.error_type: confuses GPT-4.1 uses with Sora 2 video capabilities
options.rationale: Targeted video remixing is described for Sora 2. GPT-4.1 multimodal models are used for image description, visual question answering, documents, screenshots, charts, and diagrams.
options.better_fit: Choose this when discussing Sora 2 video generation and remixing.

feedback.intrinsic: The learner would assign a video-remix capability to the wrong model family.
feedback.instructional: Keep GPT-4.1 tied to text-plus-image understanding; Sora 2 is the model named for video remixing.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. GPT-4.1 multimodal models are used for text-plus-image understanding tasks.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This reverses the role of visual input in an agent workflow.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would treat two names for the same idea as different concepts.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: GPT with vision is another name for vision-enabled GPT models.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would make the model capabilities too narrow.
